body.message:
Hello,

I rented an apartment in MAG 318, and I am extremely unhappy with the situation and the poor management of my complaints.

Since the first day I moved in, the bathroom ceiling has been leaking badly. I reported this issue many times, and although several people were sent to “fix” it, the problem is still not solved. The ceiling and bathroom are continuously leaking, there is a terrible smell, and it is becoming impossible to properly use the bathroom.

On top of that, the person responsible for handling my issues keeps ignoring my messages, does not reply, and sometimes does not even open them. This level of negligence is completely unacceptable.

I also requested two access cards from the beginning, but I only received one working card while the second card is inactive. This issue has also been ignored for a long time.

I am seriously frustrated with this situation. Please connect me with another responsible person or manager immediately who can properly solve these problems. I expect urgent action as soon as possible.

Thank you.
